usage.outputShape: body.url (final URL), body.title (page title), body.content (page content as markdown)
usage.guide: POST to https://stableenrich.dev/api/firecrawl/scrape with a JSON body {"url": "<page to scrape>"}. Payment is x402 USDC on Base (~$0.013/call). The response is a plain synchronous JSON object — read the scraped page content as markdown from body.content, the page title from body.title, and the final (post-redirect) URL from body.url. Despite the "Crawl" name, this endpoint scrapes a single page, not a multi-page crawl.
